quote: Implicit representation of graphs was introduced in the Proceedings of the twentieth annual ACM symposium on Theory of computing (STOC 1988)
posed_by: Sampath Kannan, Moni Naor, Steven Rudich
note: The conjecture was first posed in their 1988 STOC paper, with subsequent journal publication in SIAM Journal on Discrete Mathematics, 5(4):596–603, 1992. It was later proven false in 2022.
